name: Are.na
description: Are.na is a platform designed for creative collaboration and content curation. It allows users to organize and connect ideas, projects, and resources in a visual and flexible way. Ideal for artists, designers, educators, and anyone looking to explore and share knowledge, Are.na provides a space to build collections of links, images, and text, fostering a community of shared learning and inspiration.
